Opening memories, a later act of recall and paragraph-linked prior events are not automatically the same knowledge. The one-penny purse remains a labelled unverified fill: seeing a coin before payment does not establish the whole purse or debts, and a room object does not prove carried ownership. The producer-only schedule guard does not prove a single body; later round2 maps lead identity to the native player and removes its separate NPC actor. Detached fresh-life publication differs from ordinary crossing/import probe, with precise guard/failure forwarding and preservation of the prior save. Round3’s reported browser bundle does not certify round4’s new kit/perspective/autosave patch. Registered fixtures, built scratch composition and unapplied shared hunks retain different states; native combat stats, dated workroom tags, actual possessions and broad shell proof stay scoped. Seven L5r seat gaps require real replay rescoring, not automatic completion from a be-seat label. The later handoff records further integration history but this receipt supplies no fresh current be-route or full-book proof.
